dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Max is a young dog who will need an experienced adopter who understands canine behavior and is prepared to provide consistent structure, boundaries, and training. Max has had a bite incident involving an unfamiliar person who approached him and attempted to leash him, so adopters should be prepared to move slowly with introductions and handling. While in our care, Max has generally been aloof and may need time and patience to build trust with new people. Due to his history and current behavior, we recommend that Max be the only pet in the home. At home, Max has displayed some typical puppy tendencies, including destructive behavior, and house soiling has been reported. His adopter should be prepared to continue house training, provide appropriate outlets for his energy, and supervise him closely as he learns appropriate household behaviors. Max will need a patient, experienced owner who can help him develop confidence, structure, and positive associations with handling and new people.
